BaselReelDetailsQuery.description: Detailed metrics and numerical retention for an owned Reel.
BaselReelDetailsQuery.returns: xig_fetch_media.basel_media_level_insights: counts, rate objects, views_over_time and reels_retentions [{index, value}].

BaselPublicInsightsQuery.description: A smaller set of Reel counts and engagement rates.
BaselPublicInsightsQuery.returns: xig_fetch_media.basel_media_public_insights. No retention curve in the observed block.

BaselAccountLevelInsightsQuery.description: Account aggregates with optional time series.

variables.period: LAST_7_DAYS | LAST_14_DAYS | LAST_30_DAYS | LAST_60_DAYS | LAST_90_DAYS | LAST_180_DAYS; live tested LAST_30_DAYS

BaselAccountLevelInsightsQuery.returns: xig_user_by_igid_v2.basel_insights: views, reach, growth and interaction metric objects, with time_series when requested.

BaselAccountLevelReelsQuery.description: A sorted, cursor-paginated list of Reels and their metrics.

variables.order_by: BY_DATE | BY_VIEWS | BY_LIKES | BY_COMMENTS | BY_REPOSTS | BY_SHARES | BY_SAVES | BY_FOLLOWERS | BY_SKIP_RATE

BaselAudienceInsightsQuery.description: Account audience demographics, follower growth and activity.

variables.period: LAST_7_DAYS | LAST_14_DAYS | LAST_30_DAYS | LAST_60_DAYS | LAST_90_DAYS | LAST_180_DAYS; live tested LAST_30_DAYS

BaselAudienceInsightsQuery.returns: xig_user_by_igid_v2.basel_insights: age, gender, locations, followers and activity. Availability depends on the account.

XIGBaselAccountLevelReelsDataDeltaQuery.description: Refresh metric counts for selected Reel IDs.

variables.media_ids: array<string>; only one ID was live tested

XIGBaselInsightsCommentsQuery.description: Read the AI comment-insights block for a Reel.
XIGBaselInsightsCommentsQuery.returns: xig_fetch_media.ai_comment_insights. Null in the live check; populated shape not verified.

BaselKitsQuery.returns: xig_basel_kits.kits(after:$after,first:50): edges and page_info. The observed list was empty.

ReelInsightsQuery.description: An alternative Reel-insights branch in shared Instagram code. Its use by the Edits screen was not established.
ReelInsightsQuery.returns: ig_reel_insights.retention.retention_curve [{timestamp_seconds, 1fpercentage}]. Curve percentage is a fraction (1 = 100%); other percentage fields may use different units. Also contains metrics and demographics.

BaselKitClearDefaultMutation.returns: xig_basel_kit_clear_default; static contract, not live tested.

BaselKitCreateMutation.description: Create an Edits kit. Changes account data.

variables.input: GraphQlCallInput; nested builder fields are not fully recovered

BaselKitCreateMutation.returns: xig_basel_kit_create; static contract, not live tested.

BaselKitDeleteMutation.returns: xig_basel_kit_delete; static contract, not live tested.

BaselKitSetDefaultMutation.returns: xig_basel_kit_set_default; static contract, not live tested.

BaselKitUpdateMutation.description: Update an Edits kit. Changes account data.

variables.input: GraphQlCallInput; name and add_members were found, remaining fields need verification

BaselKitUpdateMutation.returns: xig_basel_kit_update; static contract, not live tested.

XIGBaselInsightsRetentionSummaryMutation.description: Generate a text retention summary and hook analysis. This is not the numerical curve.
XIGBaselInsightsRetentionSummaryMutation.returns: xig_retention_summary: success, summary, start_time, end_time, hook_analysis.summary; or error.error_code/error_message. Not live tested.
